ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Command Patterns In Scheduled Task Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects scheduled task creation using "schtasks" that contain potentially suspicious or uncommon commands

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Create\\ .*")) AND (((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/sc\\ minute\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/ru\\ system\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/k.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/r.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/k\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/r\\ .*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-decode\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-enc\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ hidden\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ bypass\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ IEX.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadData.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadFile.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadString.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/c\\ start\\ \\/min\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*FromBase64String.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mshta\\ http.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mshta\\\.exe\\ http.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Tmp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%AppData\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%Temp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%tmp\\%.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*cscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*curl.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wscript.*"))))
